name: log_weight
description: Log a weight measurement in PoopJob. grams must be an integer between 300 and 50000; convert kilograms or pounds to grams first (1 kg = 1000 g, 1 lb = 453.592 g). occurred_at is optional and defaults to now.

grams.description: Required. The weight in grams, an integer from 300 to 50000. Convert from kilograms (multiply by 1000) or pounds (multiply by 453.592) first.

occurred_at.description: Optional. When the weight was measured, as ISO 8601, for example "2026-01-12T08:30:00+02:00". A value without an offset is read in the configured timezone. Defaults to now.
